item.text: {"issues":[{"coherent":"yes","description":"Reviewers object to being repeatedly prompted to buy Premium or to features being restricted to paid plans.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"I_BILLING_05","issue_name":"Repeated Premium prompts"},{"coherent":"yes","description":"Reviewers say limits on song choice, skips, playback controls, and other free features pressure them to subscribe to Premium.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"I_BILLING_06","issue_name":"Free feature restrictions"},{"coherent":"yes","description":"Reviewers criticize the combination of ads and restricted listening controls in the free tier, often comparing it unfavorably with Premium.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"I_BILLING_07","issue_name":"Free tier ads and limits"},{"coherent":"yes","description":"Reviewers accuse Spotify of supporting or tolerating bullying and demand an apology to Lisa.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"I_SUPPORT_01","issue_name":"Alleged support for bullying"},{"coherent":"no","description":"Examples span complaints and praise about customer support, account access, app problems, billing, and regional account access, without a single clear support issue.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["22e3fe92-3c3d-409a-be87-a88f7ae0b545","16fa4300-888c-49d4-a637-0b5b8a219081","f3510ca3-4447-4a01-8897-18eb22421f89"],"issue_id":"I_SUPPORT_02","issue_name":"Mixed support and account experiences"}]}
